items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: Horace Dias, I remember him when I was coming up.

ctx.x: That is a fine piano player that we left out. Horace Dias, I remember him when I was coming up. Another piano player by the name of, see his name's come to you as you go along, a fellow by the name of Pellegrini, Vic Pellegrini. He was a very fine piano player.
Did he play solo or was he playing solo?
